question: ¿Qué cinco grupos empresarios, sumando todas sus empresas, tienen el mayor monto en contratos de servicios informáticos (NAICS 5415, incluidos sus subsectores)?

attempts.query: SELECT g FROM (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(r.parent_name,''), r.name) AS g, SUM(c.amount) AS total FROM usaspending.contract c JOIN usaspending.recipient r ON r.recipient_id = c.recipient_id WHERE c.naics_code LIKE '5415%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5) t ORDER BY total DESC
